observations.title: GraphQL in cloud sessions
observations.summary: Every gh view script paid one failed GraphQL round-trip before REST. Skipped when CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE is set.

observations.title: gh auth status
observations.summary: gh auth status is red while gh api works. No script gates on it.

observations.title: CLI arguments
observations.summary: Unknown flags were silently ignored by five gh-* scripts. They now fail before any network call.

observations.title: Checkpoint errors
observations.summary: checkpoint.mjs printed a raw stack trace on invalid input. It now prints Error + Usage.

observations.title: Token audit / cache
observations.summary: Totals excluded cache tokens without saying so. Labelled, and --include-cache added.

observations.title: loop-insights fetch error
observations.summary: An unreachable source reported only 'fetch failed'. The error now carries its cause.

observations.title: Thread resolution outside CCR
